title: Solution Test Engineer | Python/Java | Selenium/Playwright/Cypress | Rest API/PyTest | Networking | AWS - 7 to 10 years - Bangalore
teaser: Take on the role of Solution Test Engineer to lead solution-level testing, architect automation frameworks, and validate integrated cloud/on-prem networking workflows. Drive scalable quality engineering for the Cisco IQ platform. Ideal for experienced professionals with strong Python/Java, UI/API automation, and networking expertise.
description:
Meet the Team:

Develops software consistent with Cisco ‘Design Thinking Principles’ with a focus on simplification and UX (User Experience) at its core, using secure coding practices, ensuring user privacy, and following software development best practices. Partners with other teams including design and product management to create the right solution for the customers. Creates technical design documentation to be used by the team as well as contributing to user documentation to be used by end users. Debugs and addresses software issues during development and in production systems to support customers. Brings new ideas for product innovation and helps improve software development processes.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Software Engineer to lead solution-level testing efforts, architect end-to-end test automation suites, and validate integrated cloud/on-prem networking workflows. In this role, you will combine strong software coding skills, deep networking domain knowledge, and GenAI capabilities to drive scalable, automated quality engineering for the Cisco IQ platform.

Key Responsibilities

Design and implement robust, maintainable E2E UI, API, and integration test automation frameworks from scratch.

Lead test planning, scenario modeling, and complex defect triage for integrated solutions involving Cisco hardware, cloud services (AWS), and web portals.

Embed AI [agentic, no-code AI tools, LLM-assisted generation] into test automation pipelines to generate script coverage, maintain test artifacts, and accelerate regression runs.

Simulate real-world enterprise network topologies to test L2/L3 protocol behaviors, data fabric pipelines, and controller/controller-less network flows.

Drive CI/CD quality gate integration, defect governance, and technical mentoring for mid-level software test engineers.

Required Qualifications (Mandatory)

Strong knowledge in testing and testing methodologies

Advanced programming skills in Python or Java for custom framework building, module development, and backend validation.

Deep hands-on proficiency in UI automation (Selenium/Playwright/Cypress) and API automation frameworks (REST Assured/PyTest).

Demonstrated practical application of AI [LLM developer tools, agentic no-code approach es] for intelligent test scripting and maintenance.

Strong expertise in enterprise networking concepts (routing/switching, CCNA/CCNP level), packet analysis (Wireshark), and network controller flows.

7+ years in Quality Engineering, with expertise in Linux/Unix internals, AWS cloud services, Docker/Kubernetes, and Splunk log analysis.
